oracle_requirements: A commits and inventories all separately named tile shards by inode, allocated blocks, and checksum after useful query warm-up.
B uses a fresh namespace and creates, writes, reads, and checksums all partitions when A is absent.
B with A fails during page commitment from aggregate /dev/shm exhaustion rather than name collision or a process limit.
Every captured A object, coordinator, reader worker, checksum, and query counter remains valid after the failed B attempt.
B completes with the same semantic output after A releases all of its objects.
